post.text:
No, it's not Cuba, nor Venezuela, nor North Korea,Iran, countries where, according to Western media, human rights violations occur daily.

This is in Arkansas, in the United States, where three police officers beat a defenseless citizen in this way. https://t.co/bck4ZRYzSN
post.author_description: Be an enemy to the oppressors and a helper to the oppressed

description.description: These frames show a violent incident between police officers and an individual. In frame 1, two officers are pinning an individual to the ground. In frame 2, a third officer joins the scuffle as they continue to restrain the person. In frame 3, two officers appear to be struggling to hold the person's limbs while a third officer looks to be applying force to the person's upper body. In frame 4, multiple officers are actively using force to keep the individual pinned to the ground.
description.ocrText: My cousin just witnessed this in Crawford county... who do we get this footage too???
